source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 25 (PDF 134-144), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 25 (Organic Synthesis) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The study of organic chemistry is organized around:
(Organic chemistry ka mutala kis cheez ke gird tarteeb diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Organic chemistry ka mutala functional groups ke gird tarteeb diya gaya hai; har functional group organic compounds ki aik family ki pehchaan hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: The study of organic chemistry is organized around functional groups.

blocks.prompt:
2 A functional group is that part of an organic compound where:
(Functional group organic compound ka woh hissa hai jahan:)

options.text: sirf hydrogen atoms jure hote hain

blocks.explanation: Functional group organic compound ka woh hissa hai jahan ziyada tar reactions hote hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Functional group is a part of organic compound where most of the reactions occur.

blocks.prompt:
3 Millions of organic compounds are known. The number of functional groups is:
(Lakhon organic compounds maloom hain. Functional groups ki tadaad kitni hai?)

options.text: sirf chand, har aik aik family ki pehchaan
sirf aik, jo sab compounds mein hai

blocks.explanation: Agarche lakhon organic compounds maloom hain, functional groups sirf chand hain aur har aik compounds ki aik family ki pehchaan hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: there are only a handful of functional groups and each one serves to define a family

blocks.prompt:
4 In designing a synthesis, functional groups enable chemists to:
(Synthesis design karte waqt functional groups chemists ko kis cheez ke qabil banate hain?)

options.text: matloob product tak le jane wale reactions ka andaaza aur control

blocks.explanation: Functional groups synthesis design karne mein markazi kirdar ada karte hain; in se chemists un reactions ka andaaza aur control kar sakte hain jo matloob product tak le jate hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: They enable chemists to predict and control the reactions which ultimately lead to the desired product.

blocks.prompt:
5 Identifying the functional group present in a compound mainly helps to:
(Compound mein maujood functional group pehchanne se khaas taur par kya madad milti hai?)

options.text: us ke shole ka rang maloom karna
compound ki properties ka andaaza lagana

blocks.explanation: Functional group pehchanne se compound ki properties (khasusiyaat) ka andaaza lagaya ja sakta hai; yeh naye products aur medicines aur food additives ki purity jaanchne ke liye zaroori hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Identifying a functional group present in a compound can help to predict the properties of the compound.

blocks.prompt:
6 Knowledge of functional groups helps to ensure the purity and composition of products such as:
(Functional groups ka ilm kin products ki purity aur composition yaqeeni banane mein madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kitab medicines aur food additives ka naam leti hai jin ki purity aur composition functional groups ki maloomat se yaqeeni banai jati hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: as well as to ensure the purity and composition of the products such as medicines and food additives.

blocks.prompt:
7 Which of the following is a feature of a good synthesis?
(Achhi synthesis ki khasusiyat kaun si hai?)

options.text: mehngi starting materials aur bohat se steps
saste starting materials, kam se kam steps aur ziyada overall yield
kam overall yield aur naayaab reagents

blocks.explanation: Achhi synthesis sasti aur aasani se milne wali starting materials ko kam se kam steps aur ziyada overall yield wale raaste se product mein badalti hai (25.1).

book_ref.quote: A good synthesis of a substance involves the conversion of cheap and easily available starting materials

blocks.prompt:
8 Most organic compounds can be prepared by:
(Ziyada tar organic compounds kaise tayyar kiye ja sakte hain?)

options.text: kai mukhtalif raaston se, is liye behtareen raasta chunna parta hai

blocks.explanation: Ziyada tar organic compounds kai mukhtalif raaston se tayyar ho sakte hain, is liye behtareen raasta chunne ke liye usool (criteria) chahiye (25.1).

book_ref.quote: Most organic compounds can be prepared by a number of different routes

blocks.prompt:
9 Organic reactions used in synthesis are categorized according to whether they bring about:
(Synthesis mein istemal hone wale organic reactions ki darja-bandi kis buniyaad par hoti hai?)

options.text: functional group interconversion ya carbon-carbon bond banana

blocks.explanation: Synthesis ke kaam aane wale reactions is buniyaad par baante jate hain ke woh functional group interconversion (FGI) karte hain ya carbon-carbon bond banate hain (25.1).

book_ref.quote: They can be categorized as whether they bring about functional group interconversions (FGI) or a carbon-carbon bond formation.

blocks.prompt:
10 Carbon-carbon bond formation reactions are particularly important in synthesis because:
(Synthesis mein carbon-carbon bond banane wale reactions khaas taur par ahem kyun hain?)

options.text: target molecule saade aur chhote starting materials se joda jata hai
yeh tamam functional groups hata dete hain
in ki yield hamesha 100% hoti hai
in mein koi reagent nahi lagta

blocks.explanation: Synthesis ki bunyaadi hikmat-e-amli (strategy) target molecule ko saade aur chhote starting materials se jorna hai, is liye C–C bond banana khaas ahem hai (25.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbon-carbon bond formation reactions are particularly important because the basic strategy

blocks.prompt:
11 In synthesis, the target molecule is prepared starting from:
(Synthesis mein target molecule kis se shuru kar ke tayyar kiya jata hai?)

options.text: saade, bazaar mein milne wale compounds

blocks.explanation: Synthesis mein target molecule saade, bazaar mein milne wale compounds se aik ya kai steps mein tayyar kiya jata hai (25.1.1).

book_ref.quote: In synthesis, the target molecule is prepared starting from simple commercially available compounds.

blocks.prompt:
12 A primary aliphatic amine can be prepared in a single step by treating ammonia with:
(Primary aliphatic amine aik hi step mein ammonia ko kis ke saath react kar ke banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary aliphatic amine aik step mein haloalkane ko ammonia ke saath react kar ke banti hai: R–CH₂–Cl + NH₃ → R–CH₂–NH₂ + HCl (25.1.1).

book_ref.quote: primary aliphatic amine can be prepared in a single step by treating a haloalkane with ammonia.

blocks.prompt:
13 Under which conditions is a halogenoalkane converted into a primary amine with ammonia?
(Halogenoalkane ko ammonia se primary amine mein kin halaat mein badla jata hai?)

options.text: CCl₄ mein ghuli ammonia, kamre ke temperature par
ethanol mein ziyada ammonia ke saath band tube mein garam karna

blocks.explanation: Yeh substitution halogenoalkane ko ethanol mein ghuli hui ziyada ammonia ke saath band tube (pressure) mein garam kar ke hoti hai; CCl₄ is ki shart nahi kyun ke ammonia us mein mushkil se ghulti hai (25.1.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The substitution is done by heating the halogenoalkane with excess ammonia dissolved in ethanol

blocks.prompt:
14 In the two-step synthesis of an alkyl amine, the starting material is an alcohol because:
(Alkyl amine ki do-step synthesis mein starting material alcohol kyun liya jata hai?)

options.text: haloalkane aasani se nahi milta jab ke alcohol aasani se milta hai
alcohols haloalkanes mein nahi badal sakte
amines sirf alkanes se banti hain
alcohols ammonia se seedha amides dete hain

blocks.explanation: Haloalkane aasani se nahi milta, is liye ise alcohol se banaya jata hai jo ziyada aasani se milta hai; yun synthesis do steps mein mukammal hoti hai (25.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Since haloalkane is not easily available rather it is prepared from an alcohol

blocks.prompt:
15 In the conversion R–CH₂–OH → R–CH₂–Cl → R–CH₂–NH₂, the reagent used for the first step is:
(R–CH₂–OH → R–CH₂–Cl → R–CH₂–NH₂ mein pehle step ka reagent kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle alcohol SOCl₂ se chloroalkane banta hai, phir chloroalkane NH₃ se amine deta hai (25.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The synthesis of an alkyl amine may be completed in two steps.

blocks.prompt:
16 Retrosynthesis is best described as:
(Retrosynthesis ko behtareen taur par kaise bayan kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: synthesis jaisi, saste compounds se shuru
synthesis ka bilkul ulat, target molecule se peechhe ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis synthesis ka bilkul ulat hai: target molecule ko saade, aasani se milne wale compounds mein toda jata hai jo starting material ban saken (25.1.2).

book_ref.quote: It is exactly the opposite of the synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
17 Retrosynthesis involves the:
(Retrosynthesis mein kaun sa tareeqa (approach) istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis mein disconnection approach istemal hoti hai, jis mein target molecule ke bonds khayali taur par tode jate hain (25.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Retrosynthesis involves the disconnection approach.

blocks.prompt:
18 In retrosynthesis, which bonds of the target molecule are disconnected?
(Retrosynthesis mein target molecule ke kaun se bonds disconnect kiye jate hain?)

options.text: woh jin se structure kaafi saada ho jaye

blocks.explanation: Woh bonds disconnect kiye jate hain jin se structure kaafi saada ho jaye; kai disconnections ke baad saade, aasani se milne wale starting materials mil jate hain (25.1.2).

book_ref.quote: those bonds of the target molecule are disconnected that result in a considerable structural simplification

blocks.prompt:
19 In retrosynthesis, the abbreviation TM stands for:
(Retrosynthesis mein TM ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Target Molecule (TM) woh molecule hai jise tayyar karna hai (25.1, terminology).

book_ref.quote: Target Molecule (TM) is the molecule which is to be prepared by disconnection.

blocks.prompt:
20 In disconnection, the breaking of the target molecule into simpler starting materials is:
(Disconnection mein target molecule ka saade starting materials mein tootna kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: garmi se kiya gaya asal reaction

blocks.explanation: Disconnection mein TM ko khayali taur par (imaginary) qadam ba qadam saade starting materials mein toda jata hai (25.1, terminology).

book_ref.quote: Disconnection is a process which involves the imaginary breaking down of the TM

blocks.prompt:
21 Synthons generated by a disconnection are often:
(Disconnection se banne wale synthons aksar kaise hote hain?)

options.text: botalon mein bikne wale mustahkam neutral reagents
ionic species jo building blocks hain

blocks.explanation: Synthons target molecule ke woh tukre hain jo disconnection se bante hain; yeh aksar ionic species hote hain aur synthesis ke building blocks (bunyaadi tukre) hain (25.1, terminology).

book_ref.quote: They are often an ionic species and represent the building blocks for the synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
22 A synthetic equivalent (SE) is used in place of a synthon because the synthon:
(Synthon ki jagah synthetic equivalent (SE) kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: aam taur par ghair-mustahkam hai aur khud istemal nahi ho sakta

blocks.explanation: Synthetic equivalent woh reagent hai jo synthon ka kaam karta hai, kyun ke synthon aam taur par ghair-mustahkam (unstable) hota hai aur khud istemal nahi ho sakta (25.1, terminology).

book_ref.quote: Synthetic Equivalent (SE) is a reagent used to carry out the function of a synthon

blocks.prompt:
23 A diagram showing all possible disconnections and synthons from the target molecule to the starting materials is called:
(Woh diagram jo target molecule se starting materials tak tamam mumkina disconnections aur synthons dikhaye, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthetic tree woh diagram hai jo target molecule se starting materials tak tamam mumkina disconnections aur synthons dikhata hai (25.1, terminology).

book_ref.quote: Retrosynthetic Tree is a diagram showing all possible disconnections and synthons

blocks.prompt:
24 FGI has a crucial role in:
(FGI ka ahem kirdar kis mein hai?)

options.text: target molecules tak le jane wale raaste design karna

blocks.explanation: FGI un raaston ko design karne mein ahem kirdar ada karti hai jo target molecules tak le jate hain (FGI).

book_ref.quote: FGI has a crucial role to play in designing routes which lead to target molecules.

blocks.prompt:
25 According to the chapter, FGI allows a chemist to:
(Chapter ke mutabiq FGI chemist ko kis cheez ki ijaazat deti hai?)

options.text: TM ka carbon skeleton banana aur raasta bhi chunna

blocks.explanation: FGI se na sirf target molecule ka carbon skeleton banaya ja sakta hai balke ikhtiyar kiya jane wala raasta bhi chuna ja sakta hai (FGI).

book_ref.quote: FGI not only allows to create the carbon skeleton of the target molecule but also select the route

blocks.prompt:
26 Which conversion is NOT brought about by ammonia, according to the corrected Figure 25.3?
(Durust ki gayi Figure 25.3 ke mutabiq ammonia kaun si tabdeeli NAHI karti?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia alcohol ko amide mein nahi badalti, is liye ethanol se ethanamide wala NH₃ arrow hata diya gaya; haan ammonia haloalkane ko amine mein badalti hai (FGI, book correction; 25.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The printed Figure 25.3 has an arrow labelled NH₃ from ethanol to ethanamide

blocks.text: 25.2 Retrosynthesis and Synthesis of Some Compounds

blocks.prompt:
27 Retrosynthesis of ethyl acetate (TM) gives which simpler starting materials?
(Ethyl acetate (TM) ki retrosynthesis se kaun se saade starting materials milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ethyl acetate ke liye disconnection aur phir neutralization se acetic acid aur ethanol milte hain; chhapa hua 'benzene aur nitric acid' aniline wali misaal ka hai (25.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: For our target molecule ethyl acetate, the disconnection followed by neutralization yields acetic acid and ethanol

blocks.prompt:
28 In the retrosynthesis of ethyl acetate, synthon B is C₂H₅O⁻. Its synthetic equivalent is:
(Ethyl acetate ki retrosynthesis mein synthon B C₂H₅O⁻ hai. Is ka synthetic equivalent kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synthon A (CH₃CO⁺) ka SE acetic acid hai aur synthon B (C₂H₅O⁻) ka SE ethanol hai (25.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: For ethyl acetate the synthetic equivalents are acetic acid (for synthon A, CH₃CO⁺)

blocks.prompt:
29 While selecting synthetic equivalents, the essential condition is that they:
(Synthetic equivalents chunte waqt laazmi shart kya hai?)

options.text: aapas mein react kar ke target molecule dein

blocks.explanation: Synthetic equivalents ko aapas mein react kar ke target molecule dena chahiye; warna disconnection kisi kaam ki nahi (25.2).

book_ref.quote: While selecting synthetic equivalent molecules thus obtained, they should undergo reaction to give the target molecule.

blocks.prompt:
30 Ethyl acetate is synthesized from acetic acid and ethanol by:
(Ethyl acetate acetic acid aur ethanol se kis reaction ke zariye banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → (H₂SO₄) CH₃COOC₂H₅ + H₂O, yeh aik jaana pehchana esterification reaction hai (25.2).

book_ref.quote: Here we can design the synthesis of our TM by a very familiar esterification reaction

blocks.prompt:
31 In the esterification CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → CH₃COOC₂H₅ + X, the by-product X is:
(Esterification CH₃COOH + C₂H₅OH → CH₃COOC₂H₅ + X mein by-product X kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acetic acid aur ethanol ki esterification se ethyl acetate aur paani bante hain (25.2).

book_ref.quote: Disconnection at the position indicated will enable us to get synthon A and synthon B

blocks.prompt:
32 In the retrosynthesis of aniline, the first step is:
(Aniline ki retrosynthesis mein pehla step kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aniline ki retrosynthesis ka pehla step FGI hai jis mein amino group (–NH₂) ko nitro group (–NO₂) mein badla jata hai (25.2.2).

book_ref.quote: First step of retrosynthesis here is FGI, where amino group (NH₂) is converted into nitro (NO₂) group.

blocks.prompt:
33 FGI of –NH₂ to –NO₂ is done in the retrosynthesis of aniline because:
(Aniline ki retrosynthesis mein –NH₂ ki –NO₂ mein FGI kyun ki jati hai?)

options.text: amino group benzene par reh hi nahi sakta
nitro group electrophilic substitution se benzene par aasani se lagta hai, amino group nucleophilic substitution se nahi
nitro group esterification se hatta hai

blocks.explanation: Benzene par nitro group electrophilic substitution se aasani se lagta hai, jab ke amino group nucleophilic substitution se lagana mushkil hai (25.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Because it is easy to attach nitro group on benzene by electrophilic substitution

blocks.prompt:
34 Disconnection of nitrobenzene at the C–N bond gives the synthons:
(Nitrobenzene ko C–N bond par disconnect karne se kaun se synthons milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrobenzene ke C–N disconnection se aryl anion C₆H₅⁻ aur nitronium cation NO₂⁺ bante hain (25.2.2).

book_ref.quote: the disconnection of nitrobenzene was done from C—N bond, which created synthons of aryl anion

blocks.prompt:
35 The synthetic equivalents of the synthons C₆H₅⁻ and NO₂⁺ in the aniline example are:
(Aniline wali misaal mein synthons C₆H₅⁻ aur NO₂⁺ ke synthetic equivalents kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Synthons ko neutralize karne se benzene (C₆H₅⁻ ke liye) aur nitric acid (NO₂⁺ ke liye) synthetic equivalents milte hain (25.2.2).

book_ref.quote: These synthons were neutralized to get synthetic equivalents i.e., benzene and nitric acid molecule.

blocks.prompt:
36 How many steps (FGI, disconnection, synthetic equivalents) are shown in the retrosynthetic tree of aniline in the chapter?
(Chapter mein aniline ke retrosynthetic tree mein kitne steps (FGI, disconnection, synthetic equivalents) dikhaye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aniline ke tree mein Step I FGI, Step II disconnection aur Step III synthetic equivalents hain: teen steps (25.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Example 25.2.2: retrosynthetic tree of aniline

blocks.prompt:
37 In the retrosynthesis of acetophenone, the first disconnection is made at the:
(Acetophenone ki retrosynthesis mein pehla disconnection kis bond par hota hai?)

options.text: ring aur acyl group ke darmiyan C–C bond

blocks.explanation: Acetophenone ka disconnection C–C bond par hota hai jis se aryl anion C₆H₅⁻ aur acylium cation CH₃CO⁺ bante hain (25.2.3).

book_ref.quote: In first step the disconnection of acetophenone (TM) was done from C—C bond

blocks.prompt:
38 The cationic synthon obtained from acetophenone is called:
(Acetophenone se milne wala cationic synthon kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Acetophenone ke disconnection se aryl anion C₆H₅⁻ aur acylium cation CH₃CO⁺ milte hain (25.2.3).

book_ref.quote: which created synthons of aryl anion (C₆H₅⁻) and acylium (CH₃CO⁺) cation.

blocks.prompt:
39 The synthetic equivalents used to make acetophenone are:
(Acetophenone banane ke liye kaun se synthetic equivalents istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: C₆H₅⁻ aur CH₃CO⁺ ko neutralize karne se benzene aur acyl chloride, CH₃COCl, milte hain (25.2.3).

book_ref.quote: These synthons were neutralized to get synthetic equivalents i.e., benzene and acyl chloride molecule.

blocks.prompt:
40 The catalyst used in the Friedel-Craft acylation of benzene to acetophenone is:
(Benzene se acetophenone banane wali Friedel-Craft acylation mein catalyst kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene AlCl₃ catalyst ki maujoodgi mein acyl chloride se react karta hai (Friedel-Craft acylation): C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → C₆H₅COCH₃ + HCl (25.2.3).

book_ref.quote: in the presence of AlCl₃ as catalyst, using Friedel-Craft acylation process.

blocks.prompt:
41 In C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅COCH₃ + Y, the by-product Y is:
(C₆H₆ + CH₃COCl → (AlCl₃) C₆H₅COCH₃ + Y mein by-product Y kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ki acyl chloride se Friedel-Craft acylation se acetophenone aur HCl bante hain (25.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Synthesis of acetophenone can be done by reaction between benzene and acyl chloride

blocks.prompt:
42 The landmark synthesis of cholesterol was first achieved in the early 1950s by groups headed by:
(Cholesterol ki tareekhi synthesis 1950s ke shuru mein kin ki qiyadat wale groups ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Cholesterol pehli dafa 1950s ke shuru mein do muqabil groups ne banaya jin ki qiyadat Oxford mein Robert Robinson aur Harvard mein R.B. Woodward kar rahe the (Interesting Information).

book_ref.quote: The landmark synthesis of cholesterol was first achieved in early 1950s

blocks.prompt:
43 The known use of phenyl ethanoate in making medicines is as:
(Medicines banane mein phenyl ethanoate ka maloom istemal kya hai?)

options.text: paracetamol ke liye intermediate (yeh 4-hydroxyacetophenone mein badalta hai)

blocks.explanation: Phenyl ethanoate paracetamol ke liye intermediate (darmiyani compound) ke taur par maloom hai, yeh 4-hydroxyacetophenone mein badal jata hai; hepatitis medicines wala chhapa daawa durust nahi (Quick Check 25.2, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Its known use in making medicines is as an intermediate for paracetamol

blocks.prompt:
44 One of the most important applications of retrosynthesis is in the synthesis of:
(Retrosynthesis ka sab se ahem istemal kis ki synthesis mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis ka aik sab se ahem istemal pharmaceutical (dawaai) products ki synthesis mein hai (25.3).

book_ref.quote: One of the most important applications of retrosynthesis is in pharmaceutical product synthesis.

blocks.prompt:
45 Complex medicinal compounds can be traced back to simple, commonly available starting materials if they are:
(Pecheeda dawaai compounds ko saade, aam milne wale starting materials tak kab pohanchaya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: hawa mein tez garam kiye jayein
sahi aur mo'assar tareeqe se disconnect kiye jayein

blocks.explanation: Dawaai compounds bohat pecheeda lagte hain, lekin agar unhein sahi aur mo'assar tareeqe se disconnect kiya jaye to saade aur aam milne wale starting materials tak pohancha ja sakta hai (25.3).

book_ref.quote: if they are disconnected properly and efficiently, we can approach to very simple and commonly available starting materials

blocks.prompt:
46 The first disconnection of paracetamol is made at the:
(Paracetamol ka pehla disconnection kahan kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis ka pehla step amide group ke C–N bond ka disconnection hai (25.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The first step is the disconnection of paracetamol from C—N bond in amide group to get synthons.

blocks.prompt:
47 After the first disconnection of paracetamol, the synthetic equivalents are:
(Paracetamol ke pehle disconnection ke baad synthetic equivalents kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis ke Step II mein 4-aminophenol aur acyl chloride synthetic equivalents milte hain (25.3.1).

book_ref.quote: These synthons were neutralized to get synthetic equivalents i.e., 4-aminophenol and acyl chloride molecule.

blocks.prompt:
48 4-Aminophenol and acyl chloride react to form the amide bond of paracetamol through:
(4-Aminophenol aur acyl chloride paracetamol ka amide bond kis reaction se banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bond wahan is liye toda jata hai kyun ke us ke synthetic equivalents nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction se react karne ke liye mashhoor hain (25.3.1).

book_ref.quote: are well known to react through a nucleophilic addition-elimination reaction.

blocks.prompt:
49 In the retrosynthesis of paracetamol, FGI converts 4-aminophenol into 4-nitrophenol because:
(Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis mein FGI 4-aminophenol ko 4-nitrophenol mein kyun badalti hai?)

options.text: nitro group hi aakhri dawa hai
p-nitrophenol aasani se banta hai aur reduce ho kar p-aminophenol deta hai
p-nitrophenol acyl chloride se paracetamol deta hai

blocks.explanation: FGI is liye ki jati hai ke p-nitrophenol aasani se banta hai aur phir use reduce kar ke p-aminophenol banaya ja sakta hai (25.3.1).

book_ref.quote: FGI has been done because it is easy to prepare p-nitrophenol and it can then be reduced to p-aminophenol.

blocks.prompt:
50 In Step IV of the retrosynthesis of paracetamol, the C–N disconnection of 4-nitrophenol gives which synthons?
(Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis ke Step IV mein 4-nitrophenol ke C–N disconnection se kaun se synthons milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Step IV mein 4-nitrophenol disconnect hota hai; 4-hydroxy aryl anion HO–C₆H₄⁻ hai (chhapa hua C₆H₅⁻ nahi) aur doosra synthon nitronium cation NO₂⁺ hai (25.3.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: Step IV disconnects 4-nitrophenol (the molecule drawn in the scheme), not 4-aminophenol.

blocks.prompt:
51 In Step V of the retrosynthesis of paracetamol, the synthetic equivalents are:
(Paracetamol ki retrosynthesis ke Step V mein synthetic equivalents kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Step V ke synthetic equivalents phenol (HO–C₆H₄⁻ ke liye) aur nitric acid (NO₂⁺ ke liye) hain; chhapa hua 'benzene' ghalat hai (25.3.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: The synthetic equivalents in Step V are phenol (for the 4-hydroxy aryl anion) and nitric acid

blocks.prompt:
52 In a retrosynthetic scheme, the FGI step from 4-aminophenol back to 4-nitrophenol should be drawn with:
(Retrosynthetic scheme mein 4-aminophenol se wapas 4-nitrophenol wala FGI step kis arrow se dikhana chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Retrosynthesis mein functional group interconversion khula retrosynthetic arrow leti hai; chhapa hua forward arrow ghalat hai (25.3.1, book correction).

book_ref.quote: a functional group interconversion in retrosynthesis takes the open retrosynthetic arrow

blocks.prompt:
53 The direct synthesis of paracetamol requires:
(Paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis ke liye kya chahiye?)

options.text: kai steps ka silsila, jo retrosynthesis se samjha jata hai

blocks.explanation: Paracetamol ki seedhi synthesis ke liye kai steps chahiye, aur yeh silsila us ki retrosynthesis se samjha jata hai (25.3.1).

book_ref.quote: It can be seen that direct synthesis of paracetamol requires a series of steps.

blocks.prompt:
54 The first disconnection of aspirin is made at the:
(Aspirin ka pehla disconnection kahan kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin ki retrosynthesis ka pehla step ester linkage ke C–O bond ka disconnection hai (25.3.2).

blocks.prompt:

(Aspirin ke doosre disconnection se kaun se synthetic equivalents milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aspirin ki retrosynthesis ke Step IV mein phenol aur carbon dioxide milte hain (25.3.2).

book_ref.quote: These synthons were neutralized to get synthetic equivalents i.e., phenol and carbon dioxide molecule.
